Line.zh: 你的伙伴准备去钓鱼，承诺一旦钓到足够的鱼或在天黑前就会回来。
Line.en: Your partner prepares to go fishing and promises to return once enough fish has been found or before it gets dark.
Line.ja: Your partner prepares to go fishing and promises to return once enough fish has been found or before it gets dark.
